title: Resolve output locations from an explicit project root
observation: Synthetic example: changing the shell working directory can change the destination of a relative output path.

evidence.note: Illustrative reasoning only; no command or runtime test was executed.

conclusion: Resolve a configured relative output location against the caller-selected project root.
applies_when: A tool accepts project-relative filesystem output paths.
does_not_apply_when: The operation explicitly defines another base directory.
follow_up: Propose a focused cwd-independence check when P7 validation is designed.
